mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a CYP3A4 inducer that may increase mesalamine metabolism and reduce its therapeutic efficacy; additionally, both agents carry independent gastrointestinal and hematologic risks that could be additive.
action: Monitor mesalamine efficacy during eslicarbazepine therapy and consider dose adjustment if inflammatory bowel disease control deteriorates; routine monitoring of blood counts and renal function is advisable.
